verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit is built to gate agent-authored code. It reviews every PR automatically within moments, flags low-quality AI-generated 'Slop' PRs, and applies AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files as review criteria. It also runs inside coding-agent loops such as Claude Code and can block merges through its request-changes workflow, while a cross-repository Triage queue handles PR volume. Community reports are mixed: one user says it catches bugs Claude Code misses, while another team removed it over false positives. missing for 10: independent evidence of review accuracy or throughput at high AI-PR volume, documented depth of slop-detection criteria, consistent hands-on corroboration without false-positive complaints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer holds the line on AI-generated PRs — it verifies agent-authored code at a volume no human team could review

citations.quote: Automatically detect low-quality, AI-generated 'Slop' pull requests on GitHub repositories.
CodeRabbit requests changes when a review posts actionable inline comments and approves the pull request after the approval requirements are met
Within moments of opening a pull request, CodeRabbit analyzes your code with multiple AI models and provides actionable feedback, catching issues that are easy to miss in manual reviews.
CodeRabbit automatically detects coding guideline files such as .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md in your repository and applies them as review criteria
Claude Code can trigger CodeRabbit reviews directly through simple commands, enabling you to build features, run code reviews, and fix issues without manual intervention.
Agentic code reviews in PR, CLI, IDE, and in agent loops
Work one cross-repository queue of open pull requests, ranked by what each change needs and what it is worth, instead of one repository list at a time.
